text: おまえ　ポケモンのタマゴ　なんて　しらねー　だろ！

structure.jp: ポケモンのタマゴ　なんて

structure.en: you don't know about, do you!

patterns.name: 〜なんて
patterns.explanation: なんて after a thing means 'something like', often with a belittling tone. タマゴ　なんて = 'something like Eggs'.

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろ is short for だろう and means 'I bet' or 'right?'; しらねー is the rough form of しらない. しらねー　だろ = 'I bet you don't know'.
